description: Tsunami Notification Zones for BC is a dataset listed in British Columbia data catalogue (BC Data Catalogue), an open data portal, published or maintained by Emergency Management and Climate Readiness. The Tsunami Notification Zone classifications are used to differentiate the notification areas along the coast of BC. These Zones are used to add BC specific information to tsunami alerts issued from West Coast Alaska Tsunami Warning Center. Coverage: British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher Emergency Management and Climate Readiness. Its tags are EMCR, PEP, emergency management, emergency planning, incident management. It offers 3 resource(s) in KML, MULTIPLE, WMS. The portal shows 2025-03-05 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - British Columbia. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bc-portal.
